shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace
find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/.next/*' | head -50
cd /workspace && git log --oneline -10 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; git diff --stat HEAD 2>/dev/null | tail -5

cd /workspace && node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/next/package.json'); console.log('next', p.version)" 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/after.js 2>/dev/null && echo "after: present" || echo "after: checking..."; grep -rl "revalidateTag" node_modules/next/dist/server/exports 2>/dev/null | head -2

cd /workspace && grep -rl "export.*after" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/next-server/*.node 2>/dev/null | head; node -e "try{const s=require('next/server'); console.log('after:', typeof s.after); console.log('revalidateTag:', typeof s.revalidateTag);}catch(e){console.log('err', e.message)}"

cd /workspace && grep -rn "revalidateTag" node_modules/next/dist/server/create-dedicated-server.js node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "---exports in next/server types---"; grep -rn "export.*revalidateTag\|export.*after" node_modules/next/types/ 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /workspace && grep -rln "revalidateTag" node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---"; find node_modules/next -name "*.d.ts" -path "*server*" 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -ln "function revalidateTag\|revalidateTag:" 2>/dev/null | head -3

cd /workspace && node -e "try{const c=require('next/cache'); console.log('unstable_cache:', typeof c.unstable_cache); console.log('keys:', Object.keys(c).join(', '));}catch(e){console.log('err',e.message)}"

cd /workspace && find node_modules/next -name "*.d.ts" 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -ln "unstable_cache\|cacheTag\|use cache" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; find node_modules/next -name "cache.d.ts" -path "*cache*" 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace && find node_modules/next -name "cache-tag.d.ts" -path "*use-cache*" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | xargs cat 2>/dev/null; echo "=== revalidate impl ==="; find node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension -name "revalidate*" 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && find node_modules/next/dist -name "unstable-cache.js" -path "*spec-extension*" | head -1

cd /workspace && find node_modules/next/dist -name "after.js" -path "*server*" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; grep -rln "function after\|export.*after\b\|after =" node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/ 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /workspace && find node_modules/next/dist -path "*after*" -name "*.js" 2>/dev/null | grep -i "context\|callback" | head; echo "---search afterContext---"; grep -rln "afterContext\|AfterContext\|class.*After" node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/ 2>/dev/null | head -8
cd /workspace && grep -rn "force-no-store\|force-dynamic\|fetchCache" node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/async-storage/work-store.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

cd /workspace && grep -rln "force-dynamic" node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== how dynamic=force-dynamic maps to fetchCache ==="; grep -rn "force-dynamic" node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/app-render/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -10
cd /workspace && grep -rn "forceDynamic" node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i "fetchCache\|no-store\|forceDynamic" | head -20

cd /workspace && grep -rn "willConsumerServerCache" node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/app-render/work-unit-async-storage.external.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== impl ==="; grep -rn "function willConsumerServerCache" node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/app-render/*.js 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace && find node_modules/next -name "server.d.ts" -path "*types*" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== next/server re-exports ==="; grep -rn "revalidateTag\|after" node_modules/next/types/server.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/types/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== locate server.d.ts ==="; find node_modules/next -name "*.d.ts" 2>/dev/null | xargs grep -ln "export.*after" 2>/dev/null | head -5
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40; echo "=== tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="
cd /workspace && rm -rf .next && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -50; echo "=== build exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="
cd /workspace && (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; echo "started"; tail -5 /tmp/next-start.log

cd /workspace && echo "=== first GET (cold, runs query) ===" && curl -s -w " [time_total %{time_total}s] " http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/page1.html && echo "=== second GET (warm, cached) ===" && curl -s -w " [time_total %{time_total}s] " http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/page2.html && echo "=== product rows from page1 ===" && grep -oE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/page1.html | head -10 && echo "=== lastSynced ===" && grep -oE 'Last synced: [^<]*' /tmp/page1.html

cd /workspace && grep -raoE '"[a-f0-9]{32,64}"' /tmp/page1.html 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== search server bundle for action id / syncCatalogAction ==="; grep -raoE '[0-9a-f]{32,64}' .next/server/app/page.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; echo "=== action refs in flight ==="; grep -aoE '\$h[0-9]+|ACTION_[A-Za-z0-9_]+|"[A-Za-z0-9]{40}"' /tmp/page1.html | head

cd /workspace && echo "=== context around ACTION_ID in html ==="; grep -aoE '.{40}ACTION_ID.{80}' /tmp/page1.html | head -3; echo; echo "=== server action ids in .next/server (40-hex) ==="; grep -raoE '\b[0-9a-f]{40}\b' .next/server/ 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; echo "=== files in server/app ==="; ls .next/server/app/ 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && grep -aoE '[^<]*' /tmp/page1.html | head -25; echo "=== count of real (not in script) ==="; grep -aoE '.*' /tmp/page1.html | grep -oE '[^<]*' | head -25

cd /workspace && grep -aoE '[^<]*Laptop[^<]*[^<]*' /tmp/page1.html | head; echo "=== raw context ==="; grep -aoE '.{6}Laptop.{60}' /tmp/page1.html | head -3; echo "=== search for dollar amounts ==="; grep -aoE '\$[0-9]+' /tmp/page1.html | head

cd /workspace extract() { grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+[0-9]+' "$1" 2>/dev/null; grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' "$1" 2>/dev/null; } echo "### 1) Initial GET (cached state)" curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/s1.html grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/s1.html grep -aoE 'Last synced: [^<]*' /tmp/s1.html | head -1 echo echo "### 2) POST the sync form (progressive enhancement, Accept: text/html)" T0=$(date +%s.%N) curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3123/ \ -H 'Accept: text/html' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \ --data-urlencode '$ACTION_ID_00a26c0f790fe330a40dad5a37b253bdfb7abbf6fa=' \ -o /tmp/s2.html -w "POST time_total=%{time_total}s status=%{http_code}\n" T1=$(date +%s.%N) echo "action returned in $(echo "$T1-$T0"|bc)s -> admin can continue immediately" echo "rows in POST response (should be OLD/stale, sync runs after response):" grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/s2.html echo echo "### 3) Immediate GET right after POST (sync still running in background)" curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/s3.html grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/s3.html echo echo "### 4) Wait 2.6s for background sync (1.2s) + revalidateTag to land" sleep 2.6 echo "### 5) GET again -> SWR serves stale once + triggers background revalidate" curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/s5.html grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/s5.html echo echo "### 6) GET once more -> should be FRESH (updated prices/stock + timestamp)" sleep 0.3 curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/s6.html grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/s6.html grep -aoE 'Last synced: [^<]*' /tmp/s6.html | head -1
cd /workspace && tail -40 /tmp/next-start.log

cd /workspace echo "### RSC-style POST with Next-Action header, body []" curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3123/ \ -H "Next-Action: 00a26c0f790fe330a40dad5a37b253bdfb7abbf6fa" \ -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" \ -H "Accept: text/x-component" \ --data '[]' \ -o /tmp/rsc_action.txt -w "status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" echo "--- response (first 400 chars) ---" head -c 400 /tmp/rsc_action.txt; echo echo "### wait 2.6s for background sync + revalidate" sleep 2.6 echo "### GET (SWR stale-then-fresh)" curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/r1.html grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/r1.html sleep 0.4 curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/r2.html echo "### GET again (should be fresh if it worked)" grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/r2.html grep -aoE 'Last synced: [^<]*' /tmp/r2.html | head -1 echo "### server log tail" tail -15 /tmp/next-start.log

cd /workspace && grep -raoE '\$ACTION_ID_|ACTION_ID_|sanitizeSidebarAction|isServeRuntimeAction' .next/server/chunks/ssr/*.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; echo "=== search next source for form-post action dispatch ==="; grep -rln 'ACTION_ID' node_modules/next/dist/esm/server/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== how the form renders (method/action attrs) ==="; grep -aoE '<form[^>]*>' /tmp/s1.html | head

cd /workspace echo "### current cached state" curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/before.html grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/before.html | head -2 echo "### no-JS form POST (multipart/form-data, Accept: text/html) -> should trigger action + return HTML immediately" curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3123/ \ -H 'Accept: text/html' \ -F '$ACTION_ID_00a26c0f790fe330a40dad5a37b253bdfb7abbf6fa=' \ -o /tmp/post_html.html -w "status=%{http_code} time=%{time_total}s\n" echo "### wait 2.6s for background sync + revalidate" sleep 2.6 echo "### GET (SWR: stale once)" curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/a1.html grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/a1.html | head -2 sleep 0.4 echo "### GET again (should be FRESH -> no-JS path works)" curl -s http://localhost:3123/ -o /tmp/a2.html grep -aoE '[0-9]+[A-Za-z]+\$[0-9]+[0-9]+' /tmp/a2.html | head -2 grep -aoE 'Last synced: [^<]*' /tmp/a2.html | head -1 echo "### POST response was a real HTML page? (check for
]*>|' /tmp/post_html.html | head -2

cd /workspace && pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "server stopped"; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== .gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore
cd /workspace && git status --short; echo "--- .gitignore ---"; cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null
cd /workspace && echo "=== tsconfig.json diff (next build auto-edit) ==="; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== package.json diff (pre-existing) ==="; git diff package.json
cd /workspace && git checkout -- tsconfig.json && echo "tsconfig.json restored" && git diff --stat tsconfig.json
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; echo "=== tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="; echo; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short
cd /workspace && ls app/sync-button.tsx && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head; echo "=== tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]} ==="
